audience.title: Who can read it
audience.description: Everyone, or only readers who log in with DigiD or eHerkenning through a trusted portal. Every public surface (the public API, search, the sitemaps, DCAT, OOAPI and federation) leaves a signedIn publication out (REQ-PSR-001, REQ-PSR-002).

x-enum-labels.signedIn: Readers who log in with DigiD or eHerkenning

minimumAssurance.title: Minimum login level
minimumAssurance.description: The lowest login assurance level a portal must vouch for before a signedIn publication is served to its reader. Only meaningful when audience is signedIn (REQ-PSR-003).

actForSignedInReaders.title: May act for signed-in readers
actForSignedInReaders.description: Whether a portal holding this consumer's key may read a publication limited to signed-in readers on behalf of a reader whose login level it sends. Set by an administrator (REQ-PSR-003).
